approval.reversesPriorDirection: The superseded locked `instructions` string explicitly directed 'Do not add a Spanish or Hispanic accent and do not stylise the delivery around ethnicity in any way.' This recast deliberately reverses that direction. Recorded so it is never 'corrected' back by a later session.

design_prompt: A Mexican-American woman in her early thirties from Southern California. Native American English with the natural warmth and cadence of a US-raised Latina. Feminine, light and bright with a high forward placement - not deep, not chesty, not matronly. Professional and composed but relaxed and conversational, never stiff or read-aloud. No British, Irish, Australian or other European accent of any kind.
instructionsNote: MiniMax takes no `instructions` parameter. Delivery is carried by the designed voice itself. The 1133-char string that was part of the v1 definition does not transfer and is retained only in public/media/presenter-3-selena-navarro-voice-SELECTED-v1-sage-superseded.json.
auditionNote: The LA-1 audition exactly as generated and selected. Raw, 32 kHz / 96 kbps / -17.2 LUFS — this is the AUDITION, not a delivery master. Delivered narration is mastered to the locked standard.

measured_on_audition.comparison: The superseded sage voice measured 181.8 Hz on its own audition and 196.7 Hz on the shipped intro segment. LA-1 is materially deeper. Luis and Roger were told this before approving.

audio_standard_unchanged: mp3 · 24 kHz · mono · 128 kbps · -24.5 LUFS integrated. Single calibrated encode from raw, linear gain only — never compression or limiting. Unchanged by this recast.
RISK_voice_id_expiry: This voice_id is an account-scoped MiniMax voice-design ID. voice-design is NOT deterministic — the recorded design_prompt is not guaranteed to return this voice again. Selena carries 42 courses. If the ID lapses before those are rendered, this exact voice may be unrecoverable. MITIGATION: render early and keep every raw synthesis. Raws for ew-01 are kept outside the repo in the run's scratch directory; the delivered 24 kHz masters in public/media/ew-01-av1/ are the durable copy.
